ambiguities.intent: Compute Population / Land area in square kilometres, rounding density to 12 decimal places for downstream calculations.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the % change in population density between the two years
ambiguities.intent: Use 100 * (Population Density 2021 - Population Density 2000) / Population Density 2000.

ambiguities.source_text: Create a rank for % change in population density so that the country with the greatest change ranks 1
ambiguities.intent: Rank descending using competition ranking: equal values share the minimum rank and subsequent ranks skip positions.

ambiguities.source_text: Use the Country/Region data role to tidy up country names
ambiguities.intent: Standardise population labels to the matching country names: Virgin Islands (U.S.) to Virgin Islands; São Tomé and Príncipe to Sao Tome and Principe; Curacao to Curaçao.
When multiple land-area rows map to the same country after standardisation, combine them by summing land area (km²).
ambiguities.ref: size_agg = size_df.groupby("Country / Dependency", as_index=False)["Land in km2"].sum()

ambiguities.intent: Remove square-bracket and parenthetical annotations and trim names; Greenland (Denmark) becomes Greenland, not Denmark. Standardise U.S. Virgin Islands to Virgin Islands, Jan Mayen/Svalbard to Svalbard, São Tomé and Príncipe to Sao Tome and Principe, and Jersey/Guernsey to Channel Islands.
